primary.title: 8th Pay Commission: Proposed fitment factor 3.833 vs 4 — impact on salary hike explained
primary.summary: 8th Pay Commission: A major salary boost is expected for central government employees as unions push for a higher fitment factor. The fitment factor comparison between 3.833 and 4 explains the rationale for stronger pay demands, improved pensions and an inflation-linked basic pay revision.
